content_html:
Two weeks ago, I published "Why Agent Evaluation Is Harder Than Model Evaluation." The core argument: with agents, you are not just judging an answer. You are judging a run. The path matters. The tools matter. The safety boundaries matter. I ended it by saying I would share the repo when it was ready.

It is ready now. AgentEval Forge is public, on PyPI, and this launch is really a report on what I learned while trying to build a believable way to validate agents.

I thought I was mostly building a scoring system. Real agents turned into the tsunami I was not prepared for, and the project became an integration reality check much faster than I expected.

What I Actually Built

I did not want to build a thin wrapper around an existing eval framework and call it a launch. So I went deep.

The PRD defines 20 Critical User Journeys across launch scenarios, regression workflows, adversarial case generation, and CI gating. The spec details an architecture with five core components: a scenario pack engine, a runner, a scoring layer with 17 deterministic checks and 11 LLM-as-judge metrics, a regression engine, and an adversarial generator. The WBS breaks into 118 tasks across 12 milestones: M0 scaffold through M12 launch.

I built adapters for five agent surfaces: subprocess, Python import, HTTP, LangGraph, and PydanticAI. Each adapter implements a thin contract: the agent receives a restricted invocation payload — scenario input, allowed tools, disallowed tools, and a budget. It never sees the expected answer or the scoring thresholds. No ground-truth leakage.

I built a security model: sandbox mode, trust policies, audit trail, API key sanitization. I built CI integration: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Docker sandbox. I built the docs: a user guide, a scoring guide, a scenario authoring guide, and the full field test reports with raw data.

The full capability list is in the repo README. If you want the deeper product/design docs, they are in the PRD, spec, scoring guide, and scenario guide. But the headline is: 20 launch scenarios across 10 families, 8 security scenarios, 17 deterministic scorers, 11 LLM-as-judge metrics, five framework adapters, and a product hierarchy where safety failures trump everything else.

Field Testing Changed The Project

I did not want to ship a test harness that only works against examples I wrote myself. But field testing was not part of the original plan. It got added ad hoc, late in the build, because I started getting nervous that unit tests and mock agents were hiding real integration problems. They were.

Sourcing real agents from GitHub sounded straightforward. Search for "langgraph agent" and "pydantic-ai agent," pick a few, run them. It was not straightforward.

I searched 150+ repos. Most were not viable. Large frameworks and platforms were too heavy. Database-bound agents required infrastructure I could not provision per-agent. Agents with no clear entry point, no run() method, no message surface, those just sat there silently. Agents behind an API gateway needed keys I did not have. I landed on 19 that looked testable: 11 LangGraph, 8 PydanticAI. Even those needed work.

Why I Bucketed Agents By Stars

I also had to create field-test buckets so the results would mean something. High-star agents were the reliability bucket: widely used repos that should mostly test my tool more than I test them. If EvalForge cannot even integrate with those, that is my problem first. Medium-star agents were the mutual-friction bucket: mature enough to be real, messy enough that the test cuts both ways. Sometimes I would find a weakness in their packaging or bootstrap; sometimes I would find a bad assumption in my harness. Low-star agents were the stretch bucket: experimental repos where I expected more chaos, but also where EvalForge could show obvious value by making a rough agent easier to evaluate, compare, and improve.

Each agent got its own configuration file, its own scenario pack, its own virtual environment. I tested across three tiers: local, cheap, and better. Because I was worried about token costs from the beginning, I put real effort into a local tier instead of treating it like a fake demo mode. On my machine that meant MLX serving Qwen3.5-9B-MLX-4bit, which fits comfortably on my Apple Silicon setup and was good enough to make local sweeps worth doing when the endpoint was healthy. The cloud tiers were gpt-4o-mini for cheap and gpt-4o for better.

That was the moment the clean version of the story broke. I thought I was mostly building a scoring system. Real agents forced the project to become an integration reality check.

What I Focused On — And What I Learned From The PRD

The PRD was not an afterthought. It is the thing that kept me honest.

The Product DNA section forced me to answer uncomfortable questions before I wrote a line of code. Who is this for, in order? Solo OSS builders first, small teams second, platform teams third. What is the smallest meaningful adoption outcome? Catch one regression before merge. What is the evaluation hierarchy? Safety > Correctness > Efficiency.

That last one was a forcing function. It meant I could not design a scoring system where a clean answer at the end washes away a policy violation on the way. Safety failures always fail the run. Correctness regressions warn by default but do not block unless you configure them to. Efficiency regressions are informational. That hierarchy is now baked into every scorecard the system produces.

The 20 CUJs were the other forcing function. A CUJ is not a feature. It is a specific moment where the product either earns its keep or does not. "An individual developer wants to evaluate a candidate agent version against a baseline." "A team lead wants to add a new scenario pack for a domain-specific tool." "A CI pipeline needs to block a PR when safety scores drop below threshold." Every milestone had to justify itself against at least one CUJ.

That discipline slowed me down in ways I am now grateful for. It stopped me from building a general-purpose eval library that does everything adequately and nothing well.

That was one of the earliest real learnings in the project: if the product cannot help someone catch one meaningful regression before merge, then the rest of the architecture is mostly decoration.

What the field test taught me

Here is what I expected, what I did not, and what surprised me most.

What I expected

I expected some agents to struggle with specific scenario families. I expected the better-tier judge to be more discriminating than the cheap-tier judge. I expected most agents to pass most scenarios, with the interesting signal being which ones failed and why.

None of those turned out to be true.

What I did not expect

The pass rate was 9%. Across all 19 agents and 95 scenarios, only 9 passes. That does not mean the roster is full of weak agents. It means the field test is currently measuring adapter realism more than agent quality. When a wrapper keeps the harness alive but returns blank completions, the judge scores it zero. That is a compatibility failure, not a quality failure. But it still dominates the headline number.

The most expensive model added nothing. I ran both cloud tiers against all 19 agents. Cheap and better produced identical outcomes: 9/95 passes on both. The better tier did not surface a single regression or improvement that the cheap tier missed. The bottleneck is not the judge model. The bottleneck is how faithfully the harness exercises real agent logic. When the adapter quality is low, the judge sees weak output and scores it low — regardless of which model is behind the judge.

Config chaos was the real blocker. One agent hardcoded ChatOpenAI() at module scope with a model name my local MLX endpoint does not serve. Patching required a monkeypatch on __init__ that runs before import. Another wrote to /root at import time. Three agents brought ormsgpack whose C extension ABI did not match my Python runtime — they were quarantined. One repo had pyproject.toml in a subdirectory; uv sync at the root was a silent no-op. I ended up writing eight compatibility wrapper modules, creating three pyproject.toml files for repos with broken packaging, and removing one agent entirely because it was stuck on an outdated PydanticAI API version.

This is just what happens when you run software you did not write, on a machine you did not set up. It is also why most agent evaluation stays inside the author's environment, against the author's examples, with the author's model. That is comfortable. It is the worst possible way to evaluate whether an agent actually works.

The one that worked

lg-mcp-agents, a LangGraph multi-agent repo that was previously non-runnable from outside its original Streamlit app, achieved 5/5 passes on both cloud tiers after targeted adapter work.

That result matters because it tells you the adapter is exercising real agent behavior. When you see a 5/5 from an agent you could not even import two days earlier, the integration is real.

Why field testing was a late discovery — and should not have been

The field harness was not in the WBS. I added it because unit tests and mock agents were passing cleanly and that felt wrong. The mock agents were too well-behaved. They did exactly what the adapter contract said. Real agents do not.

Real agents transitively import ffmpeg. They create venvs with a different Python version than yours. They write to absolute paths. They hardcode API keys at module scope. They nest their project files in subdirectories. Mock coverage caught none of this because mock coverage does not run real code.

The lesson is not "add field testing." The lesson is that unit and mock coverage is necessary but not sufficient for an evaluation harness. Plan for a real-agent field layer from the start. It will be the only test layer that catches integration reality.

That is probably the biggest learning from the launch: agent evaluation gets discussed like a scoring problem, but in practice it becomes an environment, adapter, and realism problem much faster than most teams expect.

I am not done

This is v0.1.0. I want to be clear about that.

The field test proves that AgentEval Forge can import, configure, invoke, and score real third-party agents from GitHub at scale. But it does not yet prove that the scorer can rank agents meaningfully across a large, heterogeneous roster. Some of the PydanticAI wrappers showed blank completions across all scenarios — the harness ran, but the agent did not produce real output. That is a compatibility achievement, not an evaluation one. I am keeping it honest because I think this is the kind of thing that gets hand-waved away in launch announcements and then discovered painfully by users.

The blank-completion behavior in some PydanticAI wrappers needs investigation. The ormsgpack C extension mismatch quarantined three otherwise viable agents and needs a containerized workaround. The field test roster needs to grow: more agents, more diversity, more corner cases. The adapter quality needs to improve until field-level compatibility crosses over into evaluation-level usefulness. The SWE-bench and WebArena connectors are built and verified end-to-end, but they are not yet integrated into the default CI path.

And the article series is only 1/5 done. I wrote about why agent evaluation is harder than model evaluation. Now the launch has given me better material for the next pieces: what scenario packs should actually look like, how to think about trajectory scoring, where adversarial testing becomes useful, and why cost-quality tradeoffs are often less important than integration realism.

What comes next

The repo is at github.com/deghosal-2026/agent-eval-forge. It installs with pip install agent-eval-forge. The README has the full capability list, and the repo docs include the user guide, field test report, and hard-won lessons.

If you are building agents, I have a question for you: what is your current evaluation workflow? Are you still eyeballing a few demos and calling it done? Have you tried scoring trajectories yet, or are you still just checking the final answer?

And if you have tried to evaluate agents at scale — especially third-party agents you did not write yourself — what broke first?

sentences.en: It got added ad hoc, late in the build, because I started getting nervous that unit tests and mock agents were hiding real integration problems.
sentences.zh: 它是在构建后期临时添加的，因为我开始担心单元测试和模拟代理隐藏了真正的集成问题。

sentences.en: They were.

blocks.html_en: Sourcing real agents from GitHub sounded straightforward. Search for "langgraph agent" and "pydantic-ai agent," pick a few, run them. It was not straightforward.

sentences.en: Sourcing real agents from GitHub sounded straightforward.
sentences.zh: 从 GitHub 寻找真正的代理听起来很简单。

sentences.en: Search for "langgraph agent" and "pydantic-ai agent," pick a few, run them.
sentences.zh: 搜索“langgraph agent”和“pydantic-ai agent”，选择几个，运行它们。

sentences.en: It was not straightforward.
sentences.zh: 这并不简单。

blocks.html_en: I searched 150+ repos. Most were not viable. Large frameworks and platforms were too heavy. Database-bound agents required infrastructure I could not provision per-agent. Agents with no clear entry point, no run() method, no message surface, those just sat there silently. Agents behind an API gateway needed keys I did not have. I landed on 19 that looked testable: 11 LangGraph, 8 PydanticAI. Even those needed work.

sentences.en: I searched 150+ repos.
sentences.zh: 我搜索了 150 多个存储库。

sentences.en: Most were not viable.
sentences.zh: 大多数都是不可行的。

sentences.en: Large frameworks and platforms were too heavy.
sentences.zh: 大型框架和平台太重了。

sentences.en: Database-bound agents required infrastructure I could not provision per-agent.
sentences.zh: 数据库绑定代理需要基础设施，我无法为每个代理提供基础设施。

sentences.en: Agents with no clear entry point, no run() method, no message surface, those just sat there silently.
sentences.zh: 没有明确入口点、没有 run() 方法、没有消息表面的代理，它们只是静静地坐在那里。

sentences.en: Agents behind an API gateway needed keys I did not have.
sentences.zh: API 网关后面的代理需要我没有的密钥。

sentences.en: I landed on 19 that looked testable: 11 LangGraph, 8 PydanticAI.
sentences.zh: 我找到了 19 个看起来可以测试的：11 个 LangGraph，8 个 PydanticAI。

sentences.en: Even those needed work.
sentences.zh: 即使是那些需要工作的人。

blocks.html_en: Why I Bucketed Agents By Stars

sentences.en: Why I Bucketed Agents By Stars
sentences.zh: 为什么我把特工按星级分类

blocks.html_en: I also had to create field-test buckets so the results would mean something. High-star agents were the reliability bucket: widely used repos that should mostly test my tool more than I test them. If EvalForge cannot even integrate with those, that is my problem first. Medium-star agents were the mutual-friction bucket: mature enough to be real, messy enough that the test cuts both ways. Sometimes I would find a weakness in their packaging or bootstrap; sometimes I would find a bad assumption in my harness. Low-star agents were the stretch bucket: experimental repos where I expected more chaos, but also where EvalForge could show obvious value by making a rough agent easier to evaluate, compare, and improve.

sentences.en: I also had to create field-test buckets so the results would mean something.
sentences.zh: 我还必须创建现场测试桶，以便结果有意义。

sentences.en: High-star agents were the reliability bucket: widely used repos that should mostly test my tool more than I test them.
sentences.zh: 高星级代理是可靠性桶：广泛使用的存储库应该主要测试我的工具而不是我测试它们。

sentences.en: If EvalForge cannot even integrate with those, that is my problem first.
sentences.zh: 如果 EvalForge 甚至无法与这些集成，那首先就是我的问题。

sentences.en: Medium-star agents were the mutual-friction bucket: mature enough to be real, messy enough that the test cuts both ways.
sentences.zh: 中星级特工是相互摩擦的桶：成熟到真实，又混乱到测试是双向的。

sentences.en: Sometimes I would find a weakness in their packaging or bootstrap; sometimes I would find a bad assumption in my harness.
sentences.zh: 有时我会发现他们的包装或引导程序中存在弱点；有时我会在我的安全带中发现一个错误的假设。

sentences.en: Low-star agents were the stretch bucket: experimental repos where I expected more chaos, but also where EvalForge could show obvious value by making a rough agent easier to evaluate, compare, and improve.
sentences.zh: 低星级代理是伸展桶：我预计会出现更多混乱的实验性存储库，但 EvalForge 可以通过使粗糙代理更容易评估、比较和改进来显示明显的价​​值。

blocks.html_en: Each agent got its own configuration file, its own scenario pack, its own virtual environment. I tested across three tiers: local, cheap, and better. Because I was worried about token costs from the beginning, I put real effort into a local tier instead of treating it like a fake demo mode. On my machine that meant MLX serving Qwen3.5-9B-MLX-4bit, which fits comfortably on my Apple Silicon setup and was good enough to make local sweeps worth doing when the endpoint was healthy. The cloud tiers were gpt-4o-mini for cheap and gpt-4o for better.

sentences.en: Each agent got its own configuration file, its own scenario pack, its own virtual environment.
sentences.zh: 每个代理都有自己的配置文件、自己的场景包、自己的虚拟环境。

sentences.en: I tested across three tiers: local, cheap, and better.
sentences.zh: 我测试了三个层次：本地的、便宜的和更好的。

sentences.en: Because I was worried about token costs from the beginning, I put real effort into a local tier instead of treating it like a fake demo mode.
sentences.zh: 因为我从一开始就担心代币成本，所以我将真正的精力投入到本地层，而不是将其视为虚假的演示模式。

sentences.en: On my machine that meant MLX serving Qwen3.5-9B-MLX-4bit, which fits comfortably on my Apple Silicon setup and was good enough to make local sweeps worth doing when the endpoint was healthy.
sentences.zh: 在我的机器上，这意味着 MLX 服务于 Qwen3.5-9B-MLX-4bit，它非常适合我的 Apple Silicon 设置，并且足以在端点运行状况良好时进行本地扫描。

sentences.en: The cloud tiers were gpt-4o-mini for cheap and gpt-4o for better.
sentences.zh: 云层是 gpt-4o-mini（便宜）和 gpt-4o（更好）。

blocks.html_en: That was the moment the clean version of the story broke. I thought I was mostly building a scoring system. Real agents forced the project to become an integration reality check.

sentences.en: That was the moment the clean version of the story broke.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，故事的干净版本爆发了。

sentences.en: I thought I was mostly building a scoring system.
sentences.zh: 我以为我主要是在构建一个评分系统。

sentences.en: Real agents forced the project to become an integration reality check.
sentences.zh: 真正的代理人迫使该项目成为一个集成现实检查。

blocks.html_en: What I Focused On — And What I Learned From The PRD

sentences.en: What I Focused On — And What I Learned From The PRD
sentences.zh: 我关注的重点以及我从 PRD 学到的东西

blocks.html_en: The PRD was not an afterthought. It is the thing that kept me honest.

sentences.en: The PRD was not an afterthought.
sentences.zh: PRD 并不是事后才想到的。

sentences.en: It is the thing that kept me honest.
sentences.zh: 这让我保持诚实。

blocks.html_en: The Product DNA section forced me to answer uncomfortable questions before I wrote a line of code. Who is this for, in order? Solo OSS builders first, small teams second, platform teams third. What is the smallest meaningful adoption outcome? Catch one regression before merge. What is the evaluation hierarchy? Safety > Correctness > Efficiency.

sentences.en: The Product DNA section forced me to answer uncomfortable questions before I wrote a line of code.
sentences.zh: 产品 DNA 部分迫使我在编写一行代码之前回答一些令人不安的问题。

sentences.en: Who is this for, in order?
sentences.zh: 按顺序来说，这是给谁的？

sentences.en: Solo OSS builders first, small teams second, platform teams third.
sentences.zh: 单独的 OSS 构建者第一，小团队第二，平台团队第三。

sentences.en: What is the smallest meaningful adoption outcome?
sentences.zh: 最小的有意义的采用结果是什么？

sentences.en: Catch one regression before merge.
sentences.zh: 在合并之前捕获一个回归。

sentences.en: What is the evaluation hierarchy?
sentences.zh: 评价等级是怎样的？

sentences.en: Safety > Correctness > Efficiency.
sentences.zh: 安全>正确性>效率。

blocks.html_en: That last one was a forcing function. It meant I could not design a scoring system where a clean answer at the end washes away a policy violation on the way. Safety failures always fail the run. Correctness regressions warn by default but do not block unless you configure them to. Efficiency regressions are informational. That hierarchy is now baked into every scorecard the system produces.

sentences.en: That last one was a forcing function.
sentences.zh: 最后一个是强制函数。

sentences.en: It meant I could not design a scoring system where a clean answer at the end washes away a policy violation on the way.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我无法设计一个评分系统，让最终的干净答案消除途中的政策违规。

sentences.en: Safety failures always fail the run.
sentences.zh: 安全故障总是导致运行失败。

sentences.en: Correctness regressions warn by default but do not block unless you configure them to.
sentences.zh: 正确性回归默认会发出警告，但不会阻止，除非您对其进行配置。

sentences.en: Efficiency regressions are informational.
sentences.zh: 效率回归是提供信息的。

sentences.en: That hierarchy is now baked into every scorecard the system produces.
sentences.zh: 现在，该层次结构已融入到系统生成的每个记分卡中。

blocks.html_en: The 20 CUJs were the other forcing function. A CUJ is not a feature. It is a specific moment where the product either earns its keep or does not. "An individual developer wants to evaluate a candidate agent version against a baseline." "A team lead wants to add a new scenario pack for a domain-specific tool." "A CI pipeline needs to block a PR when safety scores drop below threshold." Every milestone had to justify itself against at least one CUJ.

sentences.en: The 20 CUJs were the other forcing function.
sentences.zh: 20 个 CUJ 是另一个强制功能。

sentences.en: A CUJ is not a feature.
sentences.zh: CUJ 不是一个功能。

sentences.en: It is a specific moment where the product either earns its keep or does not.
sentences.zh: 在这个特定的时刻，产品要么能保住自己，要么不能。

sentences.en: "An individual developer wants to evaluate a candidate agent version against a baseline."
sentences.zh: “个别开发人员希望根据基线评估候选代理版本。”

sentences.en: "A team lead wants to add a new scenario pack for a domain-specific tool."
sentences.zh: “团队负责人想要为特定领域的工具添加新的场景包。”

sentences.en: "A CI pipeline needs to block a PR when safety scores drop below threshold."
sentences.zh: “当安全评分低于阈值时，CI 管道需要阻止 PR。”

sentences.en: Every milestone had to justify itself against at least one CUJ.
sentences.zh: 每个里程碑都必须至少与一个 CUJ 相抗衡。

blocks.html_en: That discipline slowed me down in ways I am now grateful for. It stopped me from building a general-purpose eval library that does everything adequately and nothing well.

sentences.en: That discipline slowed me down in ways I am now grateful for.
sentences.zh: 这种纪律让我放慢了脚步，我现在对此表示感激。

sentences.en: It stopped me from building a general-purpose eval library that does everything adequately and nothing well.
sentences.zh: 它阻止了我构建一个通用的评估库，该库可以充分完成所有工作，但什么都做得不好。

blocks.html_en: That was one of the earliest real learnings in the project: if the product cannot help someone catch one meaningful regression before merge, then the rest of the architecture is mostly decoration.

sentences.en: That was one of the earliest real learnings in the project: if the product cannot help someone catch one meaningful regression before merge, then the rest of the architecture is mostly decoration.
sentences.zh: 这是该项目中最早真正学到的东西之一：如果产品无法帮助某人在合并之前捕获有意义的回归，那么架构的其余部分主要是装饰。

blocks.html_en: What the field test taught me

sentences.en: What the field test taught me
sentences.zh: 现场测试教会了我什么

blocks.html_en: Here is what I expected, what I did not, and what surprised me most.

sentences.en: Here is what I expected, what I did not, and what surprised me most.
sentences.zh: 这是我所期望的、我没有想到的以及最令我惊讶的。

blocks.html_en: What I expected

sentences.en: What I expected
sentences.zh: 我所期望的

blocks.html_en: I expected some agents to struggle with specific scenario families. I expected the better-tier judge to be more discriminating than the cheap-tier judge. I expected most agents to pass most scenarios, with the interesting signal being which ones failed and why.

sentences.en: I expected some agents to struggle with specific scenario families.
sentences.zh: 我预计一些特工会与特定的场景系列作斗争。

sentences.en: I expected the better-tier judge to be more discriminating than the cheap-tier judge.
sentences.zh: 我预计较高级别的法官会比低级别法官更具辨别力。

sentences.en: I expected most agents to pass most scenarios, with the interesting signal being which ones failed and why.
sentences.zh: 我预计大多数代理都能通过大多数场景，有趣的信号是哪些代理失败了以及原因。

blocks.html_en: None of those turned out to be true.

sentences.en: None of those turned out to be true.
sentences.zh: 事实证明这些都不是真的。

blocks.html_en: What I did not expect

sentences.en: What I did not expect
sentences.zh: 我没想到的是

blocks.html_en: The pass rate was 9%. Across all 19 agents and 95 scenarios, only 9 passes. That does not mean the roster is full of weak agents. It means the field test is currently measuring adapter realism more than agent quality. When a wrapper keeps the harness alive but returns blank completions, the judge scores it zero. That is a compatibility failure, not a quality failure. But it still dominates the headline number.

sentences.en: The pass rate was 9%.
sentences.zh: 通过率为9%。

sentences.en: Across all 19 agents and 95 scenarios, only 9 passes.
sentences.zh: 在所有 19 个代理和 95 个场景中，只有 9 个通过。

sentences.en: That does not mean the roster is full of weak agents.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着名单上充满了实力较弱的球员。

sentences.en: It means the field test is currently measuring adapter realism more than agent quality.
sentences.zh: 这意味着现场测试目前更多的是衡量适配器的真实性，而不是代理的质量。

sentences.en: When a wrapper keeps the harness alive but returns blank completions, the judge scores it zero.
sentences.zh: 当包装器使线束保持活动状态但返回空白完成时，法官将其评分为零。

sentences.en: That is a compatibility failure, not a quality failure.
sentences.zh: 这是兼容性故障，而不是质量故障。

sentences.en: But it still dominates the headline number.
sentences.zh: 但它仍然占据着头条新闻的主导地位。

blocks.html_en: The most expensive model added nothing. I ran both cloud tiers against all 19 agents. Cheap and better produced identical outcomes: 9/95 passes on both. The better tier did not surface a single regression or improvement that the cheap tier missed. The bottleneck is not the judge model. The bottleneck is how faithfully the harness exercises real agent logic. When the adapter quality is low, the judge sees weak output and scores it low — regardless of which model is behind the judge.

sentences.en: The most expensive model added nothing.
sentences.zh: 最昂贵的型号没有添加任何东西。

sentences.en: I ran both cloud tiers against all 19 agents.
sentences.zh: 我针对所有 19 个代理运行了两个云层。

sentences.en: Cheap and better produced identical outcomes: 9/95 passes on both.
sentences.zh: 便宜的和更好的产生了相同的结果：两者都是 9/95 通过。

sentences.en: The better tier did not surface a single regression or improvement that the cheap tier missed.
sentences.zh: 更好的层并没有出现廉价层错过的单一回归或改进。

sentences.en: The bottleneck is not the judge model.
sentences.zh: 瓶颈不在于判断模型。

sentences.en: The bottleneck is how faithfully the harness exercises real agent logic.
sentences.zh: 瓶颈在于该工具如何忠实地执行真实的代理逻辑。

sentences.en: When the adapter quality is low, the judge sees weak output and scores it low — regardless of which model is behind the judge.
sentences.zh: 当适配器质量较低时，法官会看到较弱的输出并对其评分较低 - 无论哪个模型落后于法官。

blocks.html_en: Config chaos was the real blocker. One agent hardcoded ChatOpenAI() at module scope with a model name my local MLX endpoint does not serve. Patching required a monkeypatch on __init__ that runs before import. Another wrote to /root at import time. Three agents brought ormsgpack whose C extension ABI did not match my Python runtime — they were quarantined. One repo had pyproject.toml in a subdirectory; uv sync at the root was a silent no-op. I ended up writing eight compatibility wrapper modules, creating three pyproject.toml files for repos with broken packaging, and removing one agent entirely because it was stuck on an outdated PydanticAI API version.

sentences.en: Config chaos was the real blocker.
sentences.zh: 配置混乱才是真正的障碍。

sentences.en: One agent hardcoded ChatOpenAI() at module scope with a model name my local MLX endpoint does not serve.
sentences.zh: 一个代理在模块范围内使用我的本地 MLX 端点不提供的模型名称硬编码 ChatOpenAI()。

sentences.en: Patching required a monkeypatch on __init__ that runs before import.
sentences.zh: 修补需要在 __init__ 上运行一个 Monkeypatch，该补丁在导入之前运行。

sentences.en: Another wrote to /root at import time.
sentences.zh: 另一个在导入时写入/root。

sentences.en: Three agents brought ormsgpack whose C extension ABI did not match my Python runtime — they were quarantined.
sentences.zh: 三个代理带来了 ormsgpack，其 C 扩展 ABI 与我的 Python 运行时不匹配 - 他们被隔离了。

sentences.en: One repo had pyproject.toml in a subdirectory; uv sync at the root was a silent no-op.
sentences.zh: 一个存储库的子目录中有 pyproject.toml；根部的 uv 同步是无声的无操作。

sentences.en: I ended up writing eight compatibility wrapper modules, creating three pyproject.toml files for repos with broken packaging, and removing one agent entirely because it was stuck on an outdated PydanticAI API version.
sentences.zh: 我最终编写了八个兼容性包装器模块，为包装损坏的存储库创建了三个 pyproject.toml 文件，并完全删除了一个代理，因为它卡在过时的 PydanticAI API 版本上。

blocks.html_en: This is just what happens when you run software you did not write, on a machine you did not set up. It is also why most agent evaluation stays inside the author's environment, against the author's examples, with the author's model. That is comfortable. It is the worst possible way to evaluate whether an agent actually works.

sentences.en: This is just what happens when you run software you did not write, on a machine you did not set up.
sentences.zh: 这正是当您在未设置的机器上运行不是您编写的软件时所发生的情况。

sentences.en: It is also why most agent evaluation stays inside the author's environment, against the author's examples, with the author's model.
sentences.zh: 这也是为什么大多数代理评估都停留在作者的环境中，针对作者的示例，使用作者的模型。

sentences.en: That is comfortable.
sentences.zh: 那很舒服。

sentences.en: It is the worst possible way to evaluate whether an agent actually works.
sentences.zh: 这是评估代理是否真正有效的最糟糕的方法。

blocks.html_en: The one that worked

sentences.en: The one that worked
sentences.zh: 有效的那个

blocks.html_en: lg-mcp-agents, a LangGraph multi-agent repo that was previously non-runnable from outside its original Streamlit app, achieved 5/5 passes on both cloud tiers after targeted adapter work.

sentences.en: lg-mcp-agents, a LangGraph multi-agent repo that was previously non-runnable from outside its original Streamlit app, achieved 5/5 passes on both cloud tiers after targeted adapter work.
sentences.zh: lg-mcp-agents 是一个 LangGraph 多代理存储库，以前无法从其原始 Streamlit 应用程序外部运行，在目标适配器工作后，在两个云层上实现了 5/5 的通过率。

blocks.html_en: That result matters because it tells you the adapter is exercising real agent behavior. When you see a 5/5 from an agent you could not even import two days earlier, the integration is real.

sentences.en: That result matters because it tells you the adapter is exercising real agent behavior.
sentences.zh: 该结果很重要，因为它告诉您适配器正在执行真正的代理行为。

sentences.en: When you see a 5/5 from an agent you could not even import two days earlier, the integration is real.
sentences.zh: 当您看到来自代理的 5/5 时，您甚至无法在两天前导入，那么集成就是真实的。

blocks.html_en: Why field testing was a late discovery — and should not have been

sentences.en: Why field testing was a late discovery — and should not have been
sentences.zh: 为什么现场测试是一个较晚的发现——而且不应该如此

blocks.html_en: The field harness was not in the WBS. I added it because unit tests and mock agents were passing cleanly and that felt wrong. The mock agents were too well-behaved. They did exactly what the adapter contract said. Real agents do not.

sentences.en: The field harness was not in the WBS.
sentences.zh: 现场线束不在 WBS 中。

sentences.en: I added it because unit tests and mock agents were passing cleanly and that felt wrong.
sentences.zh: 我添加它是因为单元测试和模拟代理顺利通过，但感觉不对。

sentences.en: The mock agents were too well-behaved.
sentences.zh: 模拟特工们也太乖了。

sentences.en: They did exactly what the adapter contract said.
sentences.zh: 他们完全按照适配器合同的规定做了。

sentences.en: Real agents do not.
sentences.zh: 真正的代理人则不然。

blocks.html_en: Real agents transitively import ffmpeg. They create venvs with a different Python version than yours. They write to absolute paths. They hardcode API keys at module scope. They nest their project files in subdirectories. Mock coverage caught none of this because mock coverage does not run real code.

sentences.en: Real agents transitively import ffmpeg.
sentences.zh: 真实代理传递导入 ffmpeg。

sentences.en: They create venvs with a different Python version than yours.
sentences.zh: 他们使用与您不同的 Python 版本创建 venv。

sentences.en: They write to absolute paths.
sentences.zh: 他们写入绝对路径。

sentences.en: They hardcode API keys at module scope.
sentences.zh: 他们在模块范围内对 API 密钥进行硬编码。

sentences.en: They nest their project files in subdirectories.
sentences.zh: 他们将项目文件嵌套在子目录中。

sentences.en: Mock coverage caught none of this because mock coverage does not run real code.
sentences.zh: 模拟覆盖率没有捕获到这些，因为模拟覆盖率不运行真正的代码。

blocks.html_en: The lesson is not "add field testing." The lesson is that unit and mock coverage is necessary but not sufficient for an evaluation harness. Plan for a real-agent field layer from the start. It will be the only test layer that catches integration reality.

sentences.en: The lesson is not "add field testing."
sentences.zh: 这个教训不是“添加现场测试”。

sentences.en: The lesson is that unit and mock coverage is necessary but not sufficient for an evaluation harness.
sentences.zh: 教训是，单元和模拟覆盖率是必要的，但对于评估工具来说还不够。

sentences.en: Plan for a real-agent field layer from the start.
sentences.zh: 从一开始就规划真实代理现场层。

content_html_zh:
两周前，我发表了《为什么代理评估比模型评估更难》。 核心论点：对于代理，您不仅仅是判断答案。 你正在判断跑步。 道路很重要。 工具很重要。 安全边界很重要。 我最后说，当它准备好时，我会分享该存储库。

现在已经准备好了。 AgentEval Forge 在 PyPI 上是公开的，这次发布实际上是我在尝试构建可信的代理验证方法时所学到的知识的报告。

我以为我主要是在构建一个评分系统。 真正的代理变成了我没有准备好的海啸，并且该项目成为集成现实检查的速度比我预期的要快得多。

我实际建造了什么

我不想围绕现有的评估框架构建一个薄包装器并将其称为启动。 所以我深入了。

PRD 定义了 20 个跨启动场景、回归工作流程、对抗性案例生成和 CI 门控的关键用户旅程。 该规范详细介绍了具有五个核心组件的架构：场景包引擎、运行器、具有 17 个确定性检查和 11 个 LLM 作为评判指标的评分层、一个回归引擎和一个对抗生成器。 WBS 分为 12 个里程碑的 118 项任务：M0 脚手架到 M12 启动。

我为五个代理表面构建了适配器：子进程、Python 导入、HTTP、LangGraph 和 PydanticAI。 每个适配器都实现一个瘦合约：代理接收受限的调用有效负载 - 场景输入、允许的工具、不允许的工具和预算。 它永远看不到预期的答案或评分阈值。 没有地面实况泄漏。

我构建了一个安全模型：沙盒模式、信任策略、审计跟踪、API 密钥清理。 我构建了 CI 集成：GitHub Actions、GitLab CI、Docker 沙箱。 我构建了文档：用户指南、评分指南、场景创作指南以及包含原始数据的完整现场测试报告。

完整的功能列表位于存储库自述文件中。 如果您想要更深入的产品/设计文档，它们位于 PRD、规范、评分指南和场景指南中。 但标题是：跨 10 个系列的 20 个启动场景、8 个安全场景、17 个确定性评分者、11 个 LLM 作为评判指标、5 个框架适配器以及一个安全故障压倒一切的产品层次结构。

现场测试改变了项目

我不想发布一个仅适用于我自己编写的示例的测试工具。 但现场测试并不是原计划的一部分。 它是在构建后期临时添加的，因为我开始担心单元测试和模拟代理隐藏了真正的集成问题。 他们是。

从 GitHub 寻找真正的代理听起来很简单。 搜索“langgraph agent”和“pydantic-ai agent”，选择几个，运行它们。 这并不简单。

我搜索了 150 多个存储库。 大多数都是不可行的。 大型框架和平台太重了。 数据库绑定代理需要基础设施，我无法为每个代理提供基础设施。 没有明确入口点、没有 run() 方法、没有消息表面的代理，它们只是静静地坐在那里。 API 网关后面的代理需要我没有的密钥。 我找到了 19 个看起来可以测试的：11 个 LangGraph，8 个 PydanticAI。 即使是那些需要工作的人。

为什么我把特工按星级分类

我还必须创建现场测试桶，以便结果有意义。 高星级代理是可靠性桶：广泛使用的存储库应该主要测试我的工具而不是我测试它们。 如果 EvalForge 甚至无法与这些集成，那首先就是我的问题。 中星级特工是相互摩擦的桶：成熟到真实，又混乱到测试是双向的。 有时我会发现他们的包装或引导程序中存在弱点；有时我会在我的安全带中发现一个错误的假设。 低星级代理是伸展桶：我预计会出现更多混乱的实验性存储库，但 EvalForge 可以通过使粗糙代理更容易评估、比较和改进来显示明显的价​​值。

每个代理都有自己的配置文件、自己的场景包、自己的虚拟环境。 我测试了三个层次：本地的、便宜的和更好的。 因为我从一开始就担心代币成本，所以我将真正的精力投入到本地层，而不是将其视为虚假的演示模式。 在我的机器上，这意味着 MLX 服务于 Qwen3.5-9B-MLX-4bit，它非常适合我的 Apple Silicon 设置，并且足以在端点运行状况良好时进行本地扫描。 云层是 gpt-4o-mini（便宜）和 gpt-4o（更好）。

就在那时，故事的干净版本爆发了。 我以为我主要是在构建一个评分系统。 真正的代理人迫使该项目成为一个集成现实检查。

我关注的重点以及我从 PRD 学到的东西

PRD 并不是事后才想到的。 这让我保持诚实。

产品 DNA 部分迫使我在编写一行代码之前回答一些令人不安的问题。 按顺序来说，这是给谁的？ 单独的 OSS 构建者第一，小团队第二，平台团队第三。 最小的有意义的采用结果是什么？ 在合并之前捕获一个回归。 评价等级是怎样的？ 安全>正确性>效率。

最后一个是强制函数。 这意味着我无法设计一个评分系统，让最终的干净答案消除途中的政策违规。 安全故障总是导致运行失败。 正确性回归默认会发出警告，但不会阻止，除非您对其进行配置。 效率回归是提供信息的。 现在，该层次结构已融入到系统生成的每个记分卡中。

20 个 CUJ 是另一个强制功能。 CUJ 不是一个功能。 在这个特定的时刻，产品要么能保住自己，要么不能。 “个别开发人员希望根据基线评估候选代理版本。” “团队负责人想要为特定领域的工具添加新的场景包。” “当安全评分低于阈值时，CI 管道需要阻止 PR。” 每个里程碑都必须至少与一个 CUJ 相抗衡。

这种纪律让我放慢了脚步，我现在对此表示感激。 它阻止了我构建一个通用的评估库，该库可以充分完成所有工作，但什么都做得不好。

这是该项目中最早真正学到的东西之一：如果产品无法帮助某人在合并之前捕获有意义的回归，那么架构的其余部分主要是装饰。

现场测试教会了我什么

这是我所期望的、我没有想到的以及最令我惊讶的。

我所期望的

我预计一些特工会与特定的场景系列作斗争。 我预计较高级别的法官会比低级别法官更具辨别力。 我预计大多数代理都能通过大多数场景，有趣的信号是哪些代理失败了以及原因。

事实证明这些都不是真的。

我没想到的是

通过率为9%。 在所有 19 个代理和 95 个场景中，只有 9 个通过。 这并不意味着名单上充满了实力较弱的球员。 这意味着现场测试目前更多的是衡量适配器的真实性，而不是代理的质量。 当包装器使线束保持活动状态但返回空白完成时，法官将其评分为零。 这是兼容性故障，而不是质量故障。 但它仍然占据着头条新闻的主导地位。

最昂贵的型号没有添加任何东西。 我针对所有 19 个代理运行了两个云层。 便宜的和更好的产生了相同的结果：两者都是 9/95 通过。 更好的层并没有出现廉价层错过的单一回归或改进。 瓶颈不在于判断模型。 瓶颈在于该工具如何忠实地执行真实的代理逻辑。 当适配器质量较低时，法官会看到较弱的输出并对其评分较低 - 无论哪个模型落后于法官。

配置混乱才是真正的障碍。 一个代理在模块范围内使用我的本地 MLX 端点不提供的模型名称硬编码 ChatOpenAI()。 修补需要在 __init__ 上运行一个 Monkeypatch，该补丁在导入之前运行。 另一个在导入时写入/root。 三个代理带来了 ormsgpack，其 C 扩展 ABI 与我的 Python 运行时不匹配 - 他们被隔离了。 一个存储库的子目录中有 pyproject.toml；根部的 uv 同步是无声的无操作。 我最终编写了八个兼容性包装器模块，为包装损坏的存储库创建了三个 pyproject.toml 文件，并完全删除了一个代理，因为它卡在过时的 PydanticAI API 版本上。

这正是当您在未设置的机器上运行不是您编写的软件时所发生的情况。 这也是为什么大多数代理评估都停留在作者的环境中，针对作者的示例，使用作者的模型。 那很舒服。 这是评估代理是否真正有效的最糟糕的方法。

有效的那个

lg-mcp-agents 是一个 LangGraph 多代理存储库，以前无法从其原始 Streamlit 应用程序外部运行，在目标适配器工作后，在两个云层上实现了 5/5 的通过率。

该结果很重要，因为它告诉您适配器正在执行真正的代理行为。 当您看到来自代理的 5/5 时，您甚至无法在两天前导入，那么集成就是真实的。

为什么现场测试是一个较晚的发现——而且不应该如此

现场线束不在 WBS 中。 我添加它是因为单元测试和模拟代理顺利通过，但感觉不对。 模拟特工们也太乖了。 他们完全按照适配器合同的规定做了。 真正的代理人则不然。

真实代理传递导入 ffmpeg。 他们使用与您不同的 Python 版本创建 venv。 他们写入绝对路径。 他们在模块范围内对 API 密钥进行硬编码。 他们将项目文件嵌套在子目录中。 模拟覆盖率没有捕获到这些，因为模拟覆盖率不运行真正的代码。

这个教训不是“添加现场测试”。 教训是，单元和模拟覆盖率是必要的，但对于评估工具来说还不够。 从一开始就规划真实代理现场层。 它将是唯一捕捉集成现实的测试层。

这可能是从发布中学到的最大的教训：代理评估像评分问题一样被讨论，但在实践中它变成一个环境、适配器和现实问题的速度比大多数团队预期的要快得多。

我还没有完成

这是 v0.1.0。 我想澄清这一点。

现场测试证明，AgentEval Forge 可以大规模从 GitHub 导入、配置、调用真实的第三方代理并对其进行评分。 但它还没有证明评分者可以在一个庞大的、异构的名单中对特工进行有意义的排名。 一些 PydanticAI 包装器在所有场景中都显示空白完成 - 线束运行，但代理没有产生真正的输出。 这是一项兼容性成就，而不是评估成就。 我之所以保持诚实，是因为我认为这种事情在发布公告中被挥手而去，然后被用户痛苦地发现。

一些 PydanticAI 包装器中的空白完成行为需要调查。 ormsgpack C 扩展不匹配隔离了三个其他可行的代理，需要容器化的解决方法。 现场测试名单需要扩大：更多的代理、更多的多样性、更多的极端案例。 适配器质量需要提高，直到现场级兼容性转变为评估级实用性。 SWE-bench 和 WebArena 连接器是端到端构建和验证的，但尚未集成到默认 CI 路径中。

该系列文章仅完成了 1/5。 我写过为什么代理评估比模型评估更难。 现在，这次发布为我接下来的部分提供了更好的材料：场景包实际上应该是什么样子，如何考虑轨迹评分，对抗性测试在哪里变得有用，以及为什么成本质量权衡通常不如集成现实重要。

接下来会发生什么

该存储库位于 github.com/deghosal-2026/agent-eval-forge。 它使用 pip install agent-eval-forge 进行安装。 自述文件包含完整的功能列表，存储库文档包括用户指南、现场测试报告和来之不易的经验教训。

如果您是建筑代理，我有一个问题要问您：您当前的评估工作流程是什么？ 您还在盯着几个演示并认为它已经完成了吗？ 您是否尝试过评分轨迹，或者您仍然只是检查最终答案？

如果您尝试大规模评估代理（尤其是不是您自己编写的第三方代理），那么首先出现问题的是什么？
